sentences.text: The documents do not state whether pre-payment charges may be levied on a floating-rate home loan to an individual sanctioned on 2025-12-31, because the no-charge rules cover loans sanctioned before December 31, 2025 or on or after January 1, 2026, not a loan sanctioned on 2025-12-31.
E3 states that a UCB shall not charge pre-payment charges for existing floating rate term loans sanctioned before December 31, 2025 for purposes other than business to individual borrowers.

E4 states that for loans sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges on all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals.
